sources.title: National Greenhouse Accounts Factors 2025
sources.use: Victorian electricity generation: 0.78 kg CO₂e/kWh. Direct natural gas combustion: 51.53 kg CO₂e/GJ (0.05153 kg/MJ). Upstream emissions are excluded.

sources.title: Heating and cooling
sources.use: Explains reverse-cycle heating and broad efficiency ranges. Our seasonal COP of 3.5 is a project assumption, not a measured product rating.

sources.title: Electrifying apartments guide
sources.publisher: City of Yarra / Unlocking Sustainable Strata
sources.use: Approximate cooktop heat-transfer efficiency: induction 90%, gas 40%. Actual performance varies with cookware and use.

sources.title: Hot water buyers guide
sources.use: Heat pumps use 60–75% less electricity than conventional electric hot water. Indicative installed heat-pump costs: $2,500–$7,500 before incentives; obtain a property-specific quote.

sources.title: Induction cooktop buyers guide
sources.use: Products cost about $600 to over $6,000. A dedicated circuit may cost $600–$1,200 and gas capping $250–$500. Other building and electrical work can add costs.

sources.title: Insulation
sources.use: Supports guidance on insulation, climate, shading and professional assessment. No insulation dollar saving or home R-value is inferred by this tool.

sources.title: Victorian Energy Upgrades for homes
sources.use: Accredited providers must confirm eligible products, installation requirements and the actual discount. No rebate is deducted from our estimates.

sources.title: New minimum energy efficiency standards
sources.use: New standards are phased in from March 2027. Timing, tenancy circumstances, appliance triggers and exemptions matter; this tool does not determine a property's legal obligations.

sources.title: Read your energy bill
sources.use: Explains usage and supply charges. Our default 30 c/kWh, 3 c/MJ and 100 c/day are editable project illustrations, not current retailer offers or regulated tariffs.
